recreation_brief: 1. Set a white 16:9 slide. 2. Draw a large rounded rectangle from ~8% to ~95% width and ~8% to ~97% height, fill #FBE3C6, border 2pt #CC0000. 3. Top-left on the panel border: white rectangle, 2pt red border, bold red 14pt text 'Block Output'; duplicate at bottom-left with 'Block Input'. 4. Left edge: text box with bold red 40pt 'Encoder Block', rotated 270° so it reads bottom-to-top. 5. Bottom of panel: 8 small token rectangles labeled X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄, [gap], Xₖ, [gap], X_{N-1}, X_N with alternating fills #2E75B6/#FFE135/#FF9FC5 and bold red letters; add 5 green dots (#00CC66) in the gaps. 6. Above it: full-width bar fill #7E2D5B with bold yellow 20pt 'Multi Head Self Attention'. 7. Stack upward, connecting each layer with thin orange (#E87722) up-arrows: row of small Y token boxes (same styling as X row); dashed orange rounded outline containing 7 red circles (#CC0000) with white '+'; full-width tan bar (#D9B779) with bold-italic dark-red 15pt 'Layer Normalization (NOT Batch Norm)'; row of Y token boxes; bold-italic dark-red label 'Feed Forward Networks [ One Hidden wi…' above a purple-bordered (#9B2D86) row of 6 pink boxes (#FF9FC5), each holding 8 green dots (#00A651) and tiny 'MLP' text; row of Y token boxes; second dashed-outline ⊕ row; second tan 'Layer Normalization (NOT Batch Norm)' bar; top row of Y token boxes Y₁…Y_N with 5 blue dots (#0033CC) in the gaps. 8. Draw dashed orange skip-connection lines from the X row and mid-stack up the sides into each ⊕ row. 9. Right side: white rounded rectangle ~62%-93% width with 4pt green (#00A000) border; inside, bottom to top: three red circles with white bold V, K, Q (K connected by a black line to the panel bottom); tan box (#DEC28B) 'Multi-Head Attention' (two lines); light-green rounded box (#90EE90, dark-green text) 'Add & Norm'; yellow box (#E3EF3F, gray text) 'Feed Forward' (two lines); second 'Add & Norm' rounded box; connect with 3pt black arrows; add a black rounded residual path from below Multi-Head Attention up the left side into the top Add & Norm, and an exit line through the panel top. 10. Bottom-left over the orange panel: small white box, green border, tiny dark-green title 'Transformer Encoder', gray rounded 'Encoder' box with black up-arrow and tiny 'Inputs' text below. 11. Top-right: yellow (#FFFF00) circle with bold red '49'.
